purposeStatement: A compact inline trend visualization (line or mini bars, no axis) for a single stat's recent movement; NOT for full charts with axes, legends, tooltips, or multi-series analytics graphs.

antiPatterns.pattern: Hand-rolling an inline <svg> polyline with hardcoded stroke colors to show a stat's trend
antiPatterns.reason: Re-invents a one-off, drifts on color/size, and bypasses token styling and registry reuse
